# Criteria enumeration gate (for irreversible action create_payment_request)
print("Task asks: Request $28 privately on Venmo from my roommate, Melissa, with a note, 'For the movie tickets'.")
criteria = [
    {"Criterion":"Amount","Exact Quote from Task":"$28","Implementation":"amount=28"},
    {"Criterion":"Privacy","Exact Quote from Task":"privately","Implementation":"private=True"},
    {"Criterion":"Recipient identity","Exact Quote from Task":"my roommate, Melissa","Implementation":"resolve Melissa via phone contacts (exact first_name='Melissa' + post-filter), then Venmo user email mapping"},
    {"Criterion":"Note/description","Exact Quote from Task":"note, 'For the movie tickets'","Implementation":"description='For the movie tickets'"}
]
for row in criteria:
    print(row)
print('Count of criteria:', len(criteria))

# Login to Venmo
creds = {c['account_name']: c['password'] for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}
venmo_token = apis.venmo.login(username='nicholas.weber@gmail.com', password=creds['venmo'])['access_token']
print('venmo token prefix:', venmo_token[:10])

# Resolve Melissa via phone contacts already known from earlier step by querying again to keep everything in-session
phone_token = apis.phone.login(username='9503658964', password=creds['phone'])['access_token']

all_contacts=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query='Melissa', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_contacts.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

melissa_exact = [c for c in all_contacts if c.get('first_name','').lower()=='melissa']
print('Melissa exact matches:', len(melissa_exact))
for c in melissa_exact:
    print('Melissa candidate:', c.get('first_name'), c.get('last_name'), c.get('email'), c.get('relationships'))

melissa = melissa_exact[0]
melissa_email = melissa.get('email')
print('Using melissa_email:', melissa_email)

# Search Venmo users by email (paginate fully)
all_users=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=venmo_token, query=melissa_email, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_users.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print('Venmo search returned users:', len(all_users))
print('First 5 users:', [(u.get('first_name'), u.get('last_name'), u.get('email')) for u in all_users[:5]])

exact_users = [u for u in all_users if (u.get('email','').lower()==melissa_email.lower())]
print('Exact email matches:', len(exact_users))
for u in exact_users:
    print('Matched Venmo user:', u.get('first_name'), u.get('last_name'), u.get('email'))
